QUOTE: At depth 1 the `callers` field is call-only. At depth 2 and above, `chain` walks both call edges and shared-key (dataflow) edges.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says depth-1 callers are call-only and mentions `edge_class: call` only as a default, so it never says callers/callees mix direct calls and dataflow in one list distinguished by `edge_class`.
